def: properly, a knob, i.e. (by implication) a roll (by extension from the end of a stick on which the manuscript was rolled)

occurrences.text: Then said I, Lo, I come (in the volume of the book it is written of me,) to do thy will, O God.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
